title: skills(objectstack-data): two published lines say `os migrate meta --from 16` strips retired keys "automatically", but the default run writes no source and `--write` strips only the sites it can prove
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing site.** Published skill text is false of the tool it describes (NORTH-STAR priority 4: a wrong sentence in a published skill is a product defect). reach: named producer, the published skill catalog (`skills/**`), which ships to customer projects through `npx skills add`. Found by the dev of #9591 (PR #22142, report `6051224331`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`) and filed by the `domain:spec` seat 1 (seat post #6017, `session_01LAi5BVvQNiYzepSAcsoFLK`). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What is false (read on `origin/main` `ef1fcb26a2`)

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/indexing.md:31`: "`os migrate meta --from 16` to strip them automatically."
- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:377`: "`os migrate meta --from 16` strips them."

The default run of `os migrate meta` writes no authored source file: `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts` declares the `write` flag with `default: false`. With `--write`, it rewrites in place only the edits it can trace to one literal in one project file, and lists every other edit with the reason it was not written (PR #22108, `a959493cdf`). Neither line is true of either route as written. An AI author reading the skill expects its sources stripped and leaves the retired keys in place.

## Contract

`packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts`, the house-sentence ruling the class pin enforces: "**It must be TRUE of the tool.**" PR #22142 (#9591) moves the house sentence to "… to list the mechanical edits for existing sources; `--write` applies the ones it can prove, and you apply the rest by hand." PR #22122 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22120, landed) already moved `skills/objectstack-upgrade` to the same vocabulary.

## Reader who acts

Triage grades and routes it. The landing site is `skills/**`, Tier H: a draft landed on an authorized approval or the maintainer's hand. Per the #9591 dev, the class pin's `WITHDRAWN_CLAIM` regex has no "strip" spelling, so the pin does not see these lines. If the fix also widens that regex (`packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts`), the widening must ride the same PR as the skill edit, or `main` goes red.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, closed included:
- 「skill objectstack-data indexing os migrate meta strip them automatically unique index retired keys」 → 0 hits.
- 「published skill says os migrate meta rewrites or strips sources but default run only lists edits --write」 → 26 hits. The nearest: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22120 (closed; `skills/objectstack-upgrade`, a different file), #10831 (closed; docs-site pages), #22123 (open; the upgrade skill's `--from 10` example). None is this.

Dedupe words: `objectstack-data indexing strip them automatically` · `os migrate meta strips skill` · `withdrawn claim strip spelling`
